children: Calgary, Alberta and Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - September 24, 2026) - NU E Power Corp.

(OTC Pink: NUEPF) (FSE: NUE1) ("NUE" or the "Company") announces that it has engaged Outside The Box Capital Inc. ("OTB") of Oakville, Ontario to provide digital communications services under a marketing services agreement effective September 23, 2026 (the "Agreement").

Under the Agreement, OTB will distribute Company content, including video, and conduct investor communications on social media. The Agreement has a term of six months, from September 23, 2026 to March 23, 2027. Promotional activity under the Agreement will begin on or after the date of this news release.

For its services, the Company has agreed to pay OTB a total fee of $150,000, plus applicable taxes, payable in six equal monthly instalments of $25,000 in cash. The Company and OTB act at arm's length, and no securities-based compensation, including options, forms part of this engagement.
OTB can be contacted at 2202 Green Orchard Place, Oakville, Ontario L6H 4V4, by email at jason@outsidethebox.capital, or by telephone at (289) 259-4455.

(OTC Pink: NUEPF) (FSE: NUE1) is an energy infrastructure development company focused on the origination, development, and advancement of integrated power and energy-park opportunities. Operating a develop-to-divest model, the Company emphasizes strategic site positioning, grid access, and disciplined stage-gated development across markets serving compute-intensive and large-load industrial demand.
